Sure, it's a small addition to the disappointing ways you could use HiLight […]

articles.desc: Slovyansk continues to be bombarded by Russian forces, making it almost uninhabitable with less than 10% of it's pre-war population remaining.

articles.title: Chipmakers warn AI demand is creating bottlenecks in automotive supply chain
articles.desc: Nexperia says it is heavily oversubscribed as chipmakers redirect capacity towards higher-margin AI data-centre products, creating shortages of mature semiconductors used in vehicles and industrial equipment. Industry executives warn that the AI investment boom is worsening bottlenecks across automotive and industrial supply chains.

articles.title: US Fed's Logan calls for two more rate hikes, possibly rapidly
articles.desc: Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan said the central bank needs at least two more quarter-point rate increases to curb persistent inflation and prevent price pressures from becoming entrenched. She suggested policymakers could accelerate the pace of tightening this winter, beginning with the Fed’s December 8-9 meeting.

articles.desc: ChatGPT is going to let you chat with verified "Business Agents" that represent a brand to help you with things like comparison shopping. The feature, available first to "eligible" e-commerce and online service businesses in the US, is launching as part of a suite of business-focused features in ChatGPT being announced today in beta. You […]

articles.desc: The AI company behind the Claude chatbot will offer its shares at between $70 and $78, which is lower than what was expected.

articles.desc: Inflation has remained high, despite some easing in fuel prices caused by the US war on Iran.

articles.desc: Iran says it is committed to non-proliferation treaty, but hardliners may be pushing for a change in nuclear policy.

articles.title: Anthropic targets $1.4 trillion valuation in massive stock market debut
articles.desc: The maker of Claude is looking to raise up to $64.4bn in one of the largest IPOs in history next week.

articles.title: India well on track to achieve $1 trillion exports target for FY27: Piyush Goyal
articles.desc: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal said India is on track to achieve its $1 trillion goods and services export target in FY27, having already recorded nearly $480 billion in exports during April-September. He highlighted opportunities from free trade agreements, particularly the proposed India-EU pact, for the automobile and mobility sectors. Goyal urged manufacturers to expand globally, boost competitiveness and leverage international partnerships to drive exports, investment and employment.

articles.title: Qatari PM’s Washington visit comes amid renewed US–Iran diplomacy
articles.desc: Nayef Al-Nabet discusses the Qatari prime minister’s visit to Washington.

articles.title: India-US hold bilateral talks in New Delhi on Customs and trade facilitation: Govt sources
articles.desc: A US delegation engaged with Indian Commerce Ministry officials to enhance bilateral trade and customs procedures. The discussions took place on November 2-3 and focused on trade facilitation frameworks. Ongoing negotiations are related to the proposed Bilateral Trade Agreement aimed at improving market access. Both nations are close to finalizing an interim trade agreement, with few issues left to resolve.

articles.title: AI training startup Mercor valued at $20 billion in latest funding round
articles.desc: Mercor said on Tuesday it had raised $750 million in a funding round that valued the AI training startup at $20 billion. The Series D round drew participation from Benchmark, Felicis, Fundomo, Nvidia and funds managed by affiliates of Apollo, among others.

articles.title: Still possible chipmaker Nexperia could reunite with Chinese operations, CEO says
articles.desc: If the split becomes permanent, however, Nexperia's Chinese parent Wingtech Technology should be compensated, interim CEO Stefan Tilger said in an interview on the sidelines of the electronica 2026 conference in Munich.

articles.title: Traders raise odds of 50 bps Fed rate hike as CPI rise exceeds expectations
articles.desc: New data has revealed that US consumer prices rose faster than anticipated, prompting speculation about interest rate changes. Fed Governor Christopher Waller suggested a half percentage point hike may be necessary if core prices continue rising. The Consumer Price Index showed a month-over-month increase of 0.4% in October, with core inflation remaining persistent. The bond market reacted strongly to these developments, significantly affecting Treasury yields.

articles.title: US stocks: Dow Jones falls 200 points as hot inflation revives rate-hike fears; Nvidia sinks
articles.desc: On Tuesday, Wall Street faced a downturn as inflation figures surpassed projections, raising worries about potential interest rate hikes. The declines were evident across the Dow Jones Industrial Average, S&P 500, and Nasdaq Composite indices. While financial stocks showed minor gains, technology shares, especially Nvidia, experienced fluctuations due to uncertainty in leadership. Anthropic's looming IPO threatens to heat up competition in the AI field.

articles.title: Easing global headwinds, lower crude oil prices may further lift rupee in coming months: Economists
articles.desc: Economists predict the Indian rupee will strengthen against the US dollar in the coming months. Factors contributing to this appreciation include lower crude oil prices and improving foreign capital inflows. Additionally, a weaker US dollar and the easing of geopolitical tensions are supporting this trend. The Reserve Bank of India has implemented measures to stabilize the currency and enhance dollar availability.

articles.title: Anthropic's potential mega IPO joins ranks of world's biggest stock market listings
articles.desc: Anthropic has kicked off its U.S. IPO roadshow, seeking to raise up to $64.4 billion by offering 825 million shares. This latest valuation stands at roughly $1.4 trillion, representing a drop from earlier estimations of $2 trillion. Notably, tech giants like Alphabet and Microsoft are set to invest $26 billion in a private placement.

articles.title: US inflation higher than expected in October - here's what is happening with prices
articles.desc: Prices rose by 0.4% over the month, driven by increases in shelter, food and energy costs.

articles.title: Amazon's Ring launches flying camera, autonomous security robot
articles.desc: Amazon's Ring on Tuesday launched a new robotics business with two autonomous security products, a flying indoor camera for homes and a roving security robot designed for businesses, as the company expands beyond its established lineup of home-security devices.

articles.title: TSMC to invest up to $1 billion in Anthropic, OpenAI
articles.desc: TSMC is set to invest up to $1 billion in the AI landscape, directing $500 million each to Anthropic and OpenAI. As Anthropic prepares for its IPO, this financial move by TSMC underscores its belief in a booming AI industry. With surging demand for AI chips, TSMC also aims to enhance its production capabilities, reinforcing its role in evolving AI infrastructure.

articles.title: US consumer prices rise above expectations in October
articles.desc: Consumer prices in the US experienced a larger-than-expected increase in October, affecting future Federal Reserve interest rates. The Consumer Price Index rose by 0.4%, following a 0.6% increase in September. Core CPI also increased, leading many to predict a rate hike in December. Despite missing year-over-year data, inflation remains significantly above the Fed's 2% target.

articles.title: New regulation for heating oil market, but no price controls
articles.desc: The Competition and Markets Authority has investigated the heating oil market in Northern Ireland and other parts of the UK.

articles.title: Russia's Yandex says nearly 3% of cloud customer data lost after attacks
articles.desc: "The remaining 2.84% cannot be recovered due to critical damage to equipment and the absence of backups on the platform by customers," the company said in its statement.

articles.title: Nvidia, Jensen Huang face shareholder lawsuit alleging investors were misled about spy affair
articles.desc: The complaint comes after President Donald Trump said the FBI is investigating the affair, which Huang has acknowledged to and apologised for. Trump said Monday that Huang told him he had no idea the person could be involved in espionage.

articles.title: Israeli AI security startup Bay raises $50 million
articles.desc: Bay says it addresses a primary barrier to AI adoption by "allowing autonomous agents to perform business-critical work safely while enterprises retain control and accountability at scale".

articles.title: US market ends lower as hot inflation data, Fed comments heighten rate worries: Stock Market Live Updates
Alibaba chip unit T-Head files confidential Hong Kong IPO application
articles.desc: China's Alibaba Group said on Tuesday that its chip unit, T-Head, has confidentially filed a listing application with the Hong Kong Stock Exchange after receiving approval to proceed with a spin-off.

articles.title: Cognizant commits over 25,000 professionals to Anthropic's Claude delivery
articles.desc: The group is focused on execution excellence, transformation and client success, with the scale to take AI from pilot to production across enterprises' core operations, the Nasdaq-listed IT company said.

articles.title: Nasdaq futures slip with Nvidia woes, Anthropic IPO in focus
articles.desc: Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang is facing scrutiny, impacting investor sentiment in the tech sector. Anthropic is preparing for a huge initial public offering, potentially raising $64.4 billion. The market is anxious about upcoming inflation data that could influence stock performance. Cooling oil prices have provided some optimism among investors and pushed Dow futures higher. Concerns over the sustainability of the AI boom continue to linger in the background.

articles.title: India may get a better trade deal: Samir Saran on renegotiating with the US
articles.desc: Following the US midterm elections, Samir Saran emphasized India's need to navigate trade negotiations with patience. He believes aggressive US tariff threats are often part of larger negotiations rather than immediate policy changes. Saran indicated that both domestic political shifts and bipartisan support in Congress ensure continuity of US trade goals. India can leverage its vast market to secure advantageous terms during negotiations.

articles.title: Anthropic's IPO: A close look at AI frontrunner's rapid growth, spiraling costs
articles.desc: Anthropic aims to raise up to $64.4 billion in an upcoming IPO, representing a significant market debut. The company plans a valuation of up to $1.02 trillion, showcasing its ambitions in AI. Founded by former OpenAI researchers, Anthropic's revenue has rapidly surged with enterprise adoption of its AI models. While facing substantial operating losses, the company remains committed to its substantial infrastructure investments.

articles.title: Anthropic targets valuation of about $1 trillion in IPO
articles.desc: Anthropic has entered into agreements with partners AMD, Broadcom, Google, Micron, Microsoft, Nvidia, and TSMC, who will purchase $26.0 billion of its Class N common stock in a private placement.

articles.title: India's unemployment rate falls to 5.1% in July-September as rural joblessness declines
articles.desc: India's unemployment rate saw a decline to 5.1% from 5.4% in the prior quarter. The decrease in unemployment primarily occurred in rural areas, where it fell to 4.3%. The survey indicated that more individuals were either working or seeking jobs during this period. Women's employment participation also improved, rising to 34.7% from 33.2%. The overall employment figure reached approximately 57.9 crore individuals in India.

articles.title: Budget 2027-28: PHDCCI urges govt to scrap LTCG tax on equities, cut STCG tax to 10%
articles.desc: PHD Chamber of Commerce and Industry has made recommendations for the Union Budget 2027-28. They have proposed abolishing long-term capital gains tax and reducing short-term capital gains tax rates. The chamber has also called for relaxed loan repayment norms and higher loan limits for MSMEs. They highlighted the economic significance of MSMEs in India's GDP and employment. Improved access to credit and equity support could enhance India's global manufacturing position.

articles.title: Microsoft presses President Trump to scuttle expected ban on Chinese data centre technology
articles.desc: Reuters reported in August that the Trump administration wants to ban US imports of new models of Chinese optical transceivers, which allow data to travel over fiber-optic cables at the speed of light within data centers. The concern is that they could be used by Beijing to steal data, install malware or disrupt service at US data centers.

articles.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's affair with alleged spy aided $7.5 billion in China chip shipments: The Information
articles.desc: Alice Huang, along with her husband and sister, built a network of companies across China and Singapore to acquire Nvidia chips, according to the report.

articles.title: Israeli forces kill Palestinian boy in West Bank, health ministry says
articles.desc: The Israeli military says its soldiers opened fire at individuals “who intended to hurl stones” at a road used by Israelis.

articles.title: US Treasury yields rise as Fed's Waller presses rate hike case
articles.desc: Following remarks from Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller, short-dated Treasury yields saw an uptick, as he proposed the necessity of action despite seemingly moderated inflation data. Waller highlighted a possible half-point rate increase if inflation intensifies, signaling potential shifts in monetary policy. Economists expect a modest rise in core inflation, guiding market anticipations as money markets now fully reflect a 25 basis point increase in December.

articles.title: Bajaj Finance issues 5.74 crore warrants to promoter for Rs 5,799 crore
articles.desc: Bajaj Finance has allotted 5.74 crore warrants to its promoter, Bajaj Finserv, for Rs 5,799 crore. The special committee of the board approved the issue at an issue price of Rs 1,010 per warrant. Each warrant is convertible into an equivalent number of equity shares of the company. A minimum of 25 percent of the consideration is payable at allotment, while the remaining 75 percent will be payable later.

articles.title: India's wheat plantings seen at record high but final output to depend on weather, FAO says
articles.desc: India is poised for record wheat planting this season, supported by government incentives and soil moisture. The final wheat output will depend significantly on weather patterns influenced by El Nino in April and May. El Nino typically brings above-average rainfall to key wheat-growing areas but may also increase flooding risks. Adequate snow cover from expected precipitation could benefit both overwintering crops and reservoir replenishment.

articles.title: FPIs turn net buyers; pour Rs 53,739 crore in D-Street in Nov so far
articles.desc: In November, foreign investors reversed a trend of selling by making substantial purchases of Indian equities. This shift followed a global sell-off triggered by AI developments affecting markets worldwide, including the US and Asia. The allure of strong domestic earnings growth alongside attractive valuations in large-cap stocks reignited investor interest in India, particularly in the financial services and technology sectors, with noteworthy activity also seen in the debt market.

articles.title: India in a 'sweet spot' amid oil volatility and currency dynamics: Kotak Neo's Anindya Banerjee
articles.desc: India is in a favourable economic position due to declining crude oil prices and increasing foreign investment inflows. The Indian rupee is currently undervalued, and there is potential for appreciation if geopolitical tensions ease. Expectations suggest one more interest rate hike from both the Federal Reserve and the Reserve Bank of India. Additionally, shifting global investment sentiment is favoring markets such as India beyond artificial intelligence stocks.

articles.title: Eurozone bond yields fall as lower energy prices ease inflation concerns
articles.desc: On Tuesday, government bond yields in the Eurozone experienced a notable drop, particularly for French and Italian bonds. The easing of inflation worries, attributed to falling oil and natural gas prices, enhanced demand for bonds. Germany's 10-year bond yield fell to 3.25%, while France's decreased to 4.69%. Boosted by the US President's calming remarks, market sentiment improved, especially for nations that had faced challenges in their bond markets.

articles.title: Faisal Islam: What the boss of US tech giant Nvidia told me about China and national security
articles.desc: Huang, who is now being investigated over an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, is far more important to the future of the world order than other tech bosses.

articles.title: Trump says FBI investigating Nvidia boss's affair with alleged Chinese spy
articles.desc: The US president said he spoke with Jensen Huang on Monday and asked him about the affair with the alleged spy.

articles.title: Why Rocket Lab shares fell despite record revenue and booming Neutron demand
articles.desc: Rocket Lab shares fell over 6% in after-hours trading after the company reported a wider-than-expected Q3 loss despite record revenue and a growing order backlog. Investors also weighed Neutron's delayed maiden launch, higher development costs and upbeat fourth-quarter revenue guidance.

articles.title: Delhi set to get Namo Yamuna River Safari; Kapil Mishra shares launch details
Why The Trade Desk stock surged 15% despite revenue decline
articles.desc: The Trade Desk shares surged 15.5% following stronger-than-expected Q3 earnings and revenue, as AI innovations, Netflix integration, strong customer retention and optimistic Q4 guidance boosted investor confidence despite declining profitability.

articles.title: Australia considers criminal penalties for rogue AI in wake of OpenAI hack
articles.desc: AI safety regulator will also be created after a rogue OpenAI agent hacked government websites.

articles.title: Who is Alice Huang, the Chinese businesswoman tied to Nvidia's CEO?
articles.desc: Known also as Huang Le, the Chinese businesswoman held senior roles at a Shanghai investment firm before becoming the controlling shareholder of Singapore-based cloud-computing company Megaspeed International, according to more than 30 publicly available financial records, corporate filings and company materials reviewed by Reuters.

articles.title: Anthropic plans IPO live stream with Dario Amodei, JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon
articles.desc: The meeting is part of the marketing effort for Anthropic’s potentially record-breaking IPO. The offering is expected to formally begin marketing as soon as early Tuesday ahead of pricing and the Nasdaq debut of its shares before the US Thanksgiving holiday, Bloomberg has reported.

articles.title: Anthropic plans IPO live stream with Amodei, JPMorgan CEO Dimon
articles.desc: Anthropic PBC is preparing for a live-streamed event featuring CEO Dario Amodei and JPMorgan Chase CEO Jamie Dimon. This event is aimed at marketing their upcoming initial public offering, which might break records. The IPO is set to begin marketing shortly and is planned to debut before the Thanksgiving holiday. Anthropic is targeting an offering size similar to SpaceX's IPO, which raised significant funding.

articles.title: What we know - and what we don't - as Nvidia investigates an alleged spy plot involving its CEO
articles.desc: China's Foreign Ministry dismissed the spying allegations on Monday, saying they amount to a smear campaign.

articles.title: Quantum could solve AI energy drain, says tech founder
articles.desc: Quantum computers could curb the vast energy demands of artificial intelligence data centres with their ability to run complex calculations, one of the tech's pioneers told AFP. Australian startup Diraq is conducting the first field test worldwide putting a small quantum computer based on a silicon chip in a commercial data centre in Sydney. Diraq's computer installed in Equinix's Sydney data centre has eight quantum bits, or qubits, on a silicon chip.

articles.title: Californians reject wealth tax for billionaires
articles.desc: Proposition 40 targeted Californian billionaires with a 5% tax on their total wealth, including assets such as shares as well as income.

articles.title: AI demand unlikely to be derailed by Nvidia CEO controversy: Taiwan supply chain executives
articles.desc: Global demand for artificial intelligence (AI) is expected to remain strong despite the controversy surrounding Nvidia Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang, with Taiwan's semiconductor supply chain sources expecting limited long-term impact on the industry, according to a news report by Focus Taiwan.

articles.title: Australia to adopt 'mandatory' AI safeguards
articles.desc: Artificial intelligence companies will have to abide by new "mandatory" safeguards when operating in Australia, Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said Tuesday. With immense renewable energy potential and vast stretches of uninhabited land, Australia has billed itself as a prime location for the data centres needed to power artificial intelligence.

articles.title: US sues Lyft, alleges discrimination against disabled riders
articles.desc: The US Justice Department sued Lyft on Monday, alleging the ride-hailing ​services provider discriminated against passengers with disabilities, including those who use service animals and mobility devices such as stowable wheelchairs.

articles.title: Anthropic unveils new Fable, Mythos models as competition heats up ahead of IPO
articles.desc: Anthropic on Monday unveiled two new AI models, Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2, as the OpenAI rival looks to strengthen its position in the fast-growing AI market ahead of its planned IPO.

articles.title: Anthropic retracts details of $69 billion IPO filing sent to bankers. Why analysts are raising worries over valuations
articles.desc: Anthropic initially shared its IPO filing details but later retracted the information due to inaccuracies. The company aimed to sell approximately 867 million shares priced between $70 and $80 each. A follow-up email clarified that these pricing details were incorrect. Anthropic indicated that an updated filing would be provided later. The company has chosen not to provide further comments regarding the situation.

articles.title: RBI said to query bank valuations of some bond derivative trades
articles.desc: India's central bank has informed some lenders about the need to adjust bond forward accounting practices. This change could impact billions of dollars in assets across the banking sector. The Reserve Bank of India suggested using Level 3 inputs for valuing bond-forward trades during recent audits. Banks have been in discussions with industry associations and clearinghouses for potential solutions and better pricing information.

articles.title: Oil falls as Trump downplays prospect of escalation with Iran
articles.desc: Oil prices fell due to President Trump's announcement regarding US military action against Iran, easing supply concerns. Brent crude futures dropped to $92.33 per barrel while WTI futures reached $86.50. Trump stated he would maintain a naval blockade in the Strait of Hormuz temporarily. OPEC's oil output increased in October, supported by higher production from Saudi Arabia and Kuwait.

articles.title: Gold dips ahead of US inflation data
articles.desc: Gold prices edged lower in early Asian trade on Tuesday as investors awaited US inflation data later in the day for clues on the Federal Reserve's next policy move.

articles.title: Dollar sellers hit pause for US inflation data
articles.desc: The trade and sentiment-sensitive Australian dollar rose by nearly 1% through Monday to sit at $0.6921 early on Tuesday and the New Zealand dollar rose even further to trade at $0.5624, with both steady in morning Asia trade.

articles.title: Global Market Today: Asian stocks rally after US tech surge, oil slump
articles.desc: South Korea’s Kospi Index jumped more than 5% in early trading while Japan’s Nikkei 225 rose nearly 3%. A broader gauge of Asian shares advanced 1.5% while futures for US benchmarks edged higher.

articles.title: The superpower battle over energy – and what it means for your bills
articles.desc: A tug-of-war between China and the US could have a big impact on energy costs, but who will win?

articles.title: Zoe Kleinman: Nvidia CEO's affair will cause ripples across US and beyond
articles.desc: Jensen Huang is being investigated by his own company over an extramarital affair with a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy.
